name: @examples/rn-brownfield
description: React Native brownfield example: rn-app/ is packaged as an AAR and an XCFramework that the native android-app/ and ios-app/ host apps embed.

scripts.android: pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-rn-app publish-local:aar && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-android-app uninstall:device && pnpm android:previous
scripts.ios: pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-rn-app package:ios && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-ios-app uninstall:sim && pnpm ios:previous
